Life at UiPath
 The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
Could that be you?
 Your mission
 You'll develop new user-facing features for one of our core products, Orchestrator, which is the centralized web platform used to manage, deploy, monitor, and schedule automations (robots, agents, apps & API workflows). You'll join a large FE focused team that builds and maintains core experiences for the platform.
 What You'll Do At UiPath
Plan, design, develop, and test software systems or applications for software enhancements and new products or features, including cloud-based tools.
Collaborate with teams across UiPath to design and engineer areas of our product and services.
Ensure technical deliverables meet customer expectations, and all requirements of quality, security, scalability, modifiability, extensibility, testability, etc.
Help establish effective and agile engineering practices.
Identify bottlenecks and bugs, devise solutions to mitigate and address these issues.
Plan feature development, design system components, and build engineering roadmap.
Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation.
 What You'll Bring To The Team
5+ years of coding experience in JavaScript (ES6+) /TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, SASS.
The ability to build a large frontend architecture that scales well.
Strong knowledge of browser APIs / performance.
The ability to promptly transform a set of functional/UX requirements into a working product with a touch of accessibility.
Mentor junior members - code reviews, pair programming and giving feedback - lift others up.
A grasp of LLM technologies.
 Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition.
